holding_summary: Suit for separation from bed and board on grounds of abandonment; husband did not abandon wife where he offered to establish a new matrimonial domicile and she refused to join him.
notes: Pure divorce/abandonment case (matrimonial domicile); no compensated occupancy, lodging, or boarding house issue.

holding_summary: Dispute over the nature of an oil and gas lease/contract and rights of locators under federal placer mining law; oil and gas leases held distinct from ordinary farm or house leases.
notes: Mineral/oil-and-gas lease case; the reference to house leases is only a passing analogy distinguishing oil leases from them, not a holding on dwelling occupancy.

holding_summary: Mortgage on co-owners' undivided interest in land attaches to the specific tract allotted on partition; such a partition-attachment clause is valid and not void for uncertainty.
notes: Mortgage/partition law dispute among heirs; no occupancy-for-pay or lodging issue.

holding_summary: Petitory action by landowner against a five-year agricultural tenant who refused to pay rent and disputed her title; tenant estopped from denying landlord's title while in possession, and tenant's improvements are liable for arrears of rent.
notes: A multi-year agricultural land lease dispute (tenant estoppel, rent arrears), not compensated occupancy of a dwelling/rooms; no lodging, boarding, or short-term letting facts.

holding_summary: Party-wall dispute: presumption that a division wall is common property does not apply where the wall separates a building from a then-vacant lot; buyer of the vacant lot acquired only the right to make the wall common by paying half its value.
notes: Party-wall/property-law dispute between adjoining owners; no occupancy-for-pay issue.

holding_summary: Possessory action for value of timber cut from land; quiet possession of timber land as owner for a year or more supports a possessory action against a party lacking superior possession, irrespective of good faith.
notes: Timber-land possessory action; no dwelling-letting or lodging facts.

holding_summary: An open-air dancing pavilion in a private amusement park operated for profit is not a 'dance hall' requiring neighboring property owners' consent under the city charter's licensing provision for barrooms, saloons, and dance halls.
notes: Municipal licensing of an amusement-park dance pavilion under police power; concerns entertainment venue regulation, not letting/boarding of dwellings or rooms, so it does not bear on the corpus's lodging-house question.

holding_summary: Jurisdictional and injunction dispute arising from mortgage foreclosure over timberland; court where mortgagor is domiciled has jurisdiction over an in personam suit and may enjoin destruction of mortgaged property even though the property lies elsewhere.
notes: Mortgage/venue/injunction dispute over timber operations; no lodging or dwelling-letting issue.

holding_summary: In a succession partition, a minor who resides with his mother in a co-owned house is not personally liable to his co-owner sister for rent; if anyone is liable it is the mother who occupied the property, and a minor's capital cannot be charged with rent absent a family meeting and court authorization.
notes: Family co-owners occupying their own inherited house, not a third party paying to occupy another's dwelling; rent dispute is among co-heirs, not a lodging/letting arrangement.

holding_summary: A materialman's lien for lumber used to build a house on another's land properly attaches to the house itself, even though title to the house passed to a purchaser; the builder occupied the land as a tenant at will/sufferance of the landowner.
notes: Mechanic's-lien dispute over a house built with landowner's consent; 'tenant at will' language describes possession of a building lot, not compensated occupancy of a dwelling by a lodger/boarder.

holding_summary: A tutor lacked authority to convey a minor's interest in land to attorneys as a fee absent public auction as required by Civil Code art. 341; a statute permitting attorneys to contract for a fee interest in litigated property does not impliedly repeal that requirement for minors.
notes: Minors' tutorship/sale-of-land case; no occupancy or lodging issue.

holding_summary: Mayor lacked authority to suppress exhibition of prize-fight films absent an ordinance actually in evidence; exception of no cause of action improperly sustained because such ordinances cannot be judicially noticed and must be proven on the merits.
notes: Movie-theater licensing/censorship dispute; unrelated to lodging or letting of dwellings.

holding_summary: Grantee of a municipal right-of-way/switch-track privilege cannot recover 'rent' from a party who tortiously uses that right of way, since no landlord-tenant relation exists, but may recover tort damages measured by rental value, subject to one-year prescription.
notes: Railroad right-of-way/switch-track franchise dispute; 'landlord and tenant' analysis is used only to reject a rent claim over street usage, not dwelling occupancy.

holding_summary: Adjoining landowner (a hotel company) and its contractor held solidarily liable in tort for construction damage (excavation, pile driving) to a neighboring building; damages measured by cost of restoration.
notes: Construction-damage tort suit between adjoining landowners; the defendant happens to be a hotel company, but the case does not address the legal character of guest/lodger occupancy.

holding_summary: Members of a hunting/fishing club acquired ownership of land by 30 years' adverse possession as joint tenants/co-owners, without need of title or good faith.
notes: Adverse-possession dispute over club-owned hunting land; no compensated occupancy or lodging issue.

holding_summary: Co-owner's acquisition of a tax title to co-owned land inures to the benefit of all co-owners; a later relinquishment made expressly 'as heir' does not convey the co-owner's separate tax-title interest to a third party.
notes: Title dispute among heirs/co-owners over land ownership; no dwelling-letting or lodging facts.

holding_summary: In a boundary/title dispute, a specific metes-and-bounds description in a deed controls over a general acreage reference, and a bona fide third-party purchaser's recorded title prevails over an unrecorded claim based on acreage discrepancy.
notes: Land title/description and registry-notice dispute; no occupancy-for-pay issue.

holding_summary: Injunction denied because plaintiff failed to prove dedication of a private plat's streets to public use in a sparsely settled, largely fictional 'village'; the mere existence of a plat naming streets is insufficient proof of dedication.
notes: Street-dedication/injunction dispute between two adjoining landowners; no lodging or dwelling-letting issue.
